name: Security & Reverse Engineering Connector
description: Inspect PCAP captures (Wireshark/tshark), check ELF/PE binary headers (Ghidra/Cutter/rizin), check security suite tools, and run authorized Nmap scans.

tools.name: security_suite_status
tools.description: Check installed binaries for Wireshark, Nmap, Burp Suite, Ghidra, Cutter, Metasploit, Hashcat, and John.

tools.name: inspect_binary
tools.description: Inspect ELF/PE/Mach-O magic header, bitness, and size before opening in Ghidra or Cutter.

tools.name: inspect_pcap
tools.description: Summarize packets from a .pcap or .pcapng file via tshark.

tools.name: nmap_scan
tools.description: Run a controlled Nmap ping or top-ports scan on an authorized host/subnet (requires explicit approval).
